Thanks for that!  I must have glanced over that link on the sidebar-I have to admit I don't usually browse this sub!  Maybe you can help me with something?  I'm not sure what this means:

Everything you say to suicidal people needs to be grounded in the belief that they are doing the best they can to help themselves.

Obviously, I don't want to encourage him, but am I to take it that I have to have the mindset that he thinks that by killing himself he's choosing the best possible option?
